state.intended_appearance: Blue wax seal body with reflective highlights along its raised rim; raised gold C/check and ring legend have broad, comparatively satin gold faces with localized bright bevel highlights. Crossed green ribbons have a restrained surface.

criteria.true: Gloss, reflection strength, highlight contrast and edge roundness suit the stated finish, whether restrained or glossy.
criteria.false: The visible finish contradicts the stated direction, even if it is competently executed in another style.
